race.description: I H Capital Trotters Rating Hcp
race.comment: MACKEL SONNY (3) had been racing well and again performed admirably at the most recent appearance, making a long run from a fair way out but finding one better at this circuit and distance. That made it three placings on the trot so a win looks imminent. SECOND TO NUN (5) has been racing well, recording top-four results in all three starts since winning at this circuit and distance. Finished third at her latest appearance, beaten 4 metres. Big handicap but she is good enough to win this. BUSTER DAN (7) also comes from the 50m mark but has claims off his win two back at this circuit and distance. FENOMENAL (4) will be fitter for recent racing and may be ready to show his best.
